lines.text: A gruesome voice appears on the Line.

lines.text: A gruesome voice appears on the Line.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: All week you've told yourself the patrol reached Calder Street in time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The voice doesn't sound like it agrees.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A gruesome voice appears on the Line.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Same quality as Calder Street's dead tone — a line pulled on purpose.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: This city will burn. And you can't stop us.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: No demands. No location. Just a promise.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Wants? I want you listening. You're good at that.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He knows your job. Maybe your building.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You give him dead air. He laughs into it.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Smart. The quiet ones last longer.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Watch the stadium. When it's full.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A click. Then the hum of an open line.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A real tip. Your authority to dispatch.
